camera-player-eye.note: A camera tagged player-eye exists in the graph, so the judge can be shown the frame the player sees. Where it points is the project's own decision — the follow-camera band is in camera.named-rig.

demo-walk.name: walk
demo-walk.note: The named config.demos entry "walk" (a short deterministic control script) runs to its end state without a console error. Optional: a project that registers no walk demo is unmeasured, not failed.

drawcalls-ceiling.note: The whole frame's honest figures from state().__render (counted at the graphics API, post pass included) stay under 1000 draw calls and 400k triangles; nothing countable is unmeasured, not failed.

player-moved.note: After the harness drives the project's own movement keys, state().player.x or .z changed; identical before and after means "the controls do not work". needs names the same paths delta() reads, so a build that reports no player — or one whose player only appears after the play script — is unmeasured, not passed.

primary-action-registers.note: state() reports actions.primary — a count of the project's main verb, whatever it is (a shot, a jump, a placed tile). The scripted controls trigger it, so the count must rise at least once.
